extension-point:plugin_action.description: The plugin contract is what a capability declares, runs with, is asked and answers, so the Host can key, run and commit any capability the same way in either execution mode.

ActionInvocation.description: One request for a capability's code, read at one catalog snapshot, with its key.
ActionInvocation.title: ActionInvocation

ActionReceipt.description: How one invocation ended, what it answered and staged, and what it cost.
ActionReceipt.title: ActionReceipt

EffectMode.description: What a capability's run may change, so the Host knows what it may run ahead of time.
EffectMode.title: EffectMode

ExecutionMode.description: Where a capability runs: the Host's kept workers, or its own sandboxed process tree.
ExecutionMode.title: ExecutionMode

Lease.description: The resources one run may hold; the network is off unless the lease grants it.

ActionSpec.description:
What a capability declares: its identity, effect, execution mode, lease, schemas, the
catalog tables it reads (`inputs`) and the parameter its as-of defaults to today in, if any
(`as_of_param`).
ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec

CatalogRead.description:
One read of the catalog: the snapshot a run reads at and each declared input's version at
that same snapshot, read together by the catalog owner, so a key never pairs one snapshot's
data with another's versions.
CatalogRead.title: CatalogRead

EffectMode.title: EffectMode

Lease.description: The resources one run may hold; the network is off unless the lease grants it.

Priority.title: Priority

ExecutionContext.description: What one run is given: its snapshot, a read-only data root, its staging folder, its lease.
ExecutionContext.title: ExecutionContext

ExecutionMode.title: ExecutionMode

operation:ACTIVITY_LIST.description: Reads one page of the activity feed, with the state of any watched Tasks.

operation:ACTIVITY_RECENT.description: Lists the newest requests grouped by agent session and goal, each with its read.

operation:ACTIVITY_REFUSALS.description: Counts refusals over the last days (30 by default), most frequent first.

operation:AGENT_ANSWER_SUBMIT.description: Submits an agent's answer to its bundle; the Host accepts it or names each problem.

operation:AGENT_BUNDLE_PREPARE.description: Writes or continues a specialist's complete bundle in its own directory; names its answer file.

operation:ANALYST_READS.description: Shows how the lead reads a review's Analyst bundles, the person's standing answer, and the bundle count it covers.

operation:ANALYST_READS_SET.description: Sets, on the person's relayed answer, whether a review's Analyst bundles are read by subagents or in the lead session, for reviews of up to the given bundle count.

operation:CANCEL.description: Requests cancellation of a Task, optionally against the Task version you read.

operation:CLI_INVOKE.description: Runs a forwarded thin CLI command with the caller's captured streams.

operation:COMMITTEE_DAILY_SET.description: Sets, on the person's relayed answer, whether each daily update's published review convenes the committee; off, the PM gives its view and the committee is offered.

operation:COMMITTEE_OPEN.description: Opens the investment committee on a date's published positions, or reads the one open; offers each member's bundle, which `bundle prepare` writes into a new, empty or matching directory.

operation:COMMITTEE_READ.description: Shows the committee's floor: its stage, members, tension points and the messages a member has not seen.

operation:COMMITTEE_SUBMIT.description: Sends one member's message to the committee's floor, checked by its rules.

operation:COMPARE.description: Compares two saved installed-strategy results: which controls differ and how metrics compare; no winner.

operation:CONTROLS.description: Lists the controls of an installed strategy's Portfolio book, with defaults and limits.

operation:CPU_BUDGET_SET.description: Sets the CPU budget (auto or a core count) or how many Tasks may wait.

operation:CPU_BUDGET_SHOW.description: Shows the CPU budget, the machine's load and how many Tasks may wait.

operation:CRO_REVIEW.description: Requests a CRO review of a book; the product runs no model, so use `bundle prepare`.

operation:CRO_REVIEW_DOSSIER.description: Delivers a book's CRO dossier and answer contract, in parts when it is large.

operation:CRO_REVIEW_FINDING.description: Delivers one CRO finding with its verified cited evidence.

operation:CRO_REVIEW_SUBMIT.description: Submits a CRO's answer to its dossier; accepted risks publish as a Task.

operation:DATA_CHANGE_CONFIRM.description: Approves a proposed data change by plan hash, admitting its Task; `run` then applies it.

operation:DATA_ISSUES.description: Lists data issues with their evidence, options, decisions and grants, a page at a time.

operation:DATA_ISSUE_CONFIRM.description: Records a data issue's chosen option; from the CLI only under a person's grant.

operation:DATA_ISSUE_DELEGATE.description: Grants automation the right to confirm one option for a preparation blocked on data review.

operation:DATA_ISSUE_PREVIEW.description: Previews one data-issue option's consequences; nothing is applied.

operation:DATA_ISSUE_REVOKE.description: Revokes a data-issue grant by its hash.

operation:DATA_UPDATE_PLAN.description: Plans a data update: due source checks, Data and Feature upkeep, any membership change; fetches nothing.

operation:DATA_UPDATE_READBACK.description: Shows the workspace's data state and the latest data update Task, or the one named.

operation:DATA_UPDATE_RUN.description: Runs a planned data update as a Task, within the workspace's network access.

operation:EVENT_DECLARE.description: Records an event this client declares about its own work in the activity feed.

operation:EVIDENCE_ANALYSIS_SUBMIT.description: Submits an Analyst's answer to a prepared packet; accepted findings publish as a Task.

operation:EVIDENCE_CONSENT.description: Shows the consent to official SEC acquisition and the budget it admits.

operation:EVIDENCE_CONSENT_SET.description: Sets the consent to official SEC acquisition: documents per issuer, in all, and bytes.

operation:EVIDENCE_CONTINUE.description: Admits one more bounded source-reading session over a prepared packet, as a Task.

operation:EVIDENCE_CRO.description: Shows a book's Evidence and CRO state, from preparation to published review.

operation:EVIDENCE_CRO_EXPORT.description: Exports a published CRO review with its dossier and verified evidence spans.

operation:EVIDENCE_DOCUMENTS.description: Lists the workspace's retained SEC documents, newest first, a page at a time; fetches nothing.

operation:EVIDENCE_INSTALL.description: Installs an Evidence source package in the running Host as a Task: its environment, model, acquisition, index and publication; served at once.

operation:EVIDENCE_LEDGER.description: Reads a book's issuer-topic reading ledger from its sealed packets, twenty groups a page.

operation:EVIDENCE_PACKET.description: Delivers one prepared evidence packet for an Analyst, whole, in parts or as a chosen detail.

operation:EVIDENCE_PREPARE.description: Prepares a book's evidence packets as a Task: acquires, reads and seals sources; no findings.

operation:EVIDENCE_PREVIEW.description: Previews a book's evidence preparation: scope, sources and prerequisites; no Task or acquisition.

operation:EVIDENCE_REFRESH.description: Requests an evidence refresh; the product runs no model, so use `bundle prepare`.

operation:EVIDENCE_SELECT.description: Records which published analysis a book's review reads; refuses one that is not eligible.

operation:EXPERIENCE_BRIEF.description: Reads what to know before new work on a goal, as known at a time, fitted to a token budget in priority order: its current decisions, then lessons, then similar experiences.

operation:EXPERIENCE_CLASS.description: Reads every trial of a trial's class, across goals, workspaces and agents, as known at a time: each member and its measures, each metric's spread and the search's size.

operation:EXPERIENCE_READ.description: Reads recorded trials, their measures and conclusions.

operation:EXPERIENCE_RECALL.description: Recalls the experiences most like a query in a workspace, as known at a time, each with its text and its trials' classes; refused by name until the retrieval models are installed.

operation:EXPERIENCE_RECORD.description: Records a review's note on an ended trial or Task, or on a goal, with its verdict; the Host renders the note into an experience.

operation:EXPERIENCE_SQL.description: Answers one read-only SELECT over the history's views and their macros, at most 1,000 rows, with no table, file, network or path past them in reach; anything else is refused by name.

operation:EXPERIMENTS.description: Lists every study Task with its kind, input and declared choices.

operation:EXPERIMENT_ALPHA_COMPARE.description: Compares two saved Alpha candidates from stored evidence; names no winner, recomputes nothing.

operation:EXPERIMENT_COMPARE.description: Compares two completed Portfolio books on the same input and support; names no winner.

operation:EXPERIMENT_CONTINUE.description: Continues a saved study by drafting, planning and running its next version in one request.

operation:EXPERIMENT_CONTROLS.description: Shows the controls and an editable declaration for a new study on a research input.

operation:EXPERIMENT_CURATE.description: Records a Factor study's curation decision: which factors go on, and why; no Task.

operation:EXPERIMENT_CURATION.description: Shows a completed Factor study's curation choices and what a decision must name.

operation:EXPERIMENT_DECLARATION_CONVERT.description: Converts a declaration between JSON and YAML; admits no plan or Task.

operation:EXPERIMENT_DELIVERY_EXPORT.description: Exports one delivery report binding a selected book with its comparison, Risk link and review.

operation:EXPERIMENT_DRAFT.description: Copies a completed study's declaration for editing, onto its own input or a chosen one.

operation:EXPERIMENT_EXPORT.description: Exports a verified study as JSON, YAML and HTML with an export hash.

operation:EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATIONS.description: Lists Foundation admissions with each current, historical or refused read.

operation:EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_DRAFT.description: Drafts the Alpha declaration that builds on a sealed Foundation.

operation:EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_EXPORT.description: Exports a sealed Foundation admission as JSON.

operation:EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_PREVIEW.description: Previews the Foundation a curated Factor study would seal; nothing is sealed.

operation:EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_READBACK.description: Shows one sealed Foundation by its admission hash, read from its recorded graph.

operation:EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_SEAL.description: Seals the Foundation admission just previewed, named by its admission hash.

operation:EXPERIMENT_FOUNDATION_SUMMARY.description: Reads one sealed admission's label metadata without verifying its source graph.

operation:EXPERIMENT_HANDOFF_PREVIEW.description: Previews the Alpha declaration built on a curated Factor decision; nothing is planned or run.

operation:EXPERIMENT_LINK_RISK.description: Attaches a completed Risk study's report to a Portfolio book as evidence; weights unchanged.

operation:EXPERIMENT_PLAN.description: Plans a study from its declaration and keeps the plan for an hour; nothing runs.

operation:EXPERIMENT_PORTFOLIO_DRAFT.description: Drafts a Portfolio book declaration from one candidate of a completed Alpha study.

operation:EXPERIMENT_PREVIEW_READBACK.description: Shows a kept plan by its hash: available, expired, invalid or missing, and what follows.

operation:EXPERIMENT_PROMOTE.description: Runs an explored study's declaration on its whole universe as a Task, or reuses it.

operation:EXPERIMENT_READBACK.description: Shows a saved study verified against its sealed evidence, its standing first.

operation:EXPERIMENT_REPLAY.description: Checks a saved study still matches the installed code and evidence; recomputes nothing, admits no Task.

operation:EXPERIMENT_RISK_EXPORT.description: Exports one linked Risk report of a Portfolio book as HTML with its hash.

operation:EXPERIMENT_RISK_LINKS.description: Lists the Risk reports linked to a Portfolio book, each with its export request.

operation:EXPERIMENT_RUN.description: Runs a kept plan as a Task, optionally testing a stated hypothesis.

operation:EXPERIMENT_SUMMARY.description: Shows a completed Alpha study's recorded model, training facts and metrics, without re-verifying evidence.

operation:EXPERIMENT_VERIFY_ALL.description: Verifies every saved study's sealed evidence in full, as a Task that yields to waiting work.

operation:EXPORT.description: Returns the export manifest of a saved result; recomputes nothing.

operation:FEATURE_ACTIVATE.description: Activates a reviewed formula factor into the workspace's daily feature catalog.

operation:FEATURE_CATALOG_BUILD.description: Builds a planned feature's raw or preprocessed values as a Task.

operation:FEATURE_CATALOG_BUILD_READBACK.description: Shows a feature build Task: its verified columns, counts and what they can feed.

operation:FEATURE_CATALOG_CONTROLS.description: Shows the formula language, admitted recipes and an editable feature declaration for an input.

operation:FEATURE_CATALOG_PLAN.description: Plans a feature change from its declaration and saves the plan; nothing is built.

operation:FEATURE_CATALOG_READBACK.description: Shows a saved feature plan: its changes, work and next requests.

operation:FEATURE_DEACTIVATE.description: Removes an activated formula factor from the workspace's daily feature catalog.

operation:FEATURE_EXTENSIONS.description: Lists the formula factors the workspace's plans declare, with activation and latest trial.

operation:FEATURE_REVIEW.description: Shows a formula factor's review packet: contract, trials, build coverage and activation.

operation:FEATURE_TRIAL.description: Starts or reopens a trial: builds a planned feature, screens it, reruns a finished study.

operation:FEATURE_TRIALS.description: Lists feature trials with their state and current step.

operation:FEATURE_TRIAL_READBACK.description: Shows a feature trial's steps and, once complete, its comparison; changes nothing.

operation:FINALIZATION.description: Shows a frozen candidate's release state and next permitted action; grants nothing.

operation:FREEZE.description: Freezes a saved development result, by its hash, as a candidate for finalization.

operation:GOAL_ABANDON.description: Closes an open goal as abandoned, recording why.

operation:GOAL_ATTACH.description: Attaches an exact read to the goal as evidence under a stage.

operation:GOAL_CONTINUE.description: Returns the draft that continues a study linked to the goal; plans and runs nothing.

operation:GOAL_EXPORT.description: Exports a goal's verified record, with the book deliveries it names, as JSON, YAML or HTML.

operation:GOAL_LIST.description: Lists goals newest first, a page at a time, or those of one agent session.

operation:GOAL_NARRATIVE.description: Shows a goal's saved revision as recorded, without re-verifying its evidence.

operation:GOAL_NOTE.description: Records a decision, conclusion or open hypothesis in the goal's record.

operation:GOAL_OPEN.description: Opens a goal from its declaration and binds this agent session to it; the Host mints a new goal's id, and a goal_id opens only an existing goal.

operation:GOAL_PROFILE.description: Reads recorded stage times and coverage for a goal.

operation:GOAL_REFERENCE.description: Verifies one named reference of an exact saved goal revision at its owner.

operation:GOAL_REVISE.description: Revises an open goal's declaration with a reason; a changed objective marks earlier evidence post hoc.

operation:GOAL_SCHEMA.description: Prints the goal declaration, reference, note and submission schemas, with a starter declaration.

operation:GOAL_SHOW.description: Shows a goal's latest or a chosen revision, re-verifying every reference at its owner.

operation:GOAL_SUBMIT.description: Submits the completion document; the Host seals the goal complete or lists what is missing.

operation:GOAL_TAKE.description: Binds this agent session to an open goal, so its requests are recorded under it.

operation:HOST_STOP.description: Stops this workspace's Host at safe points and retains Tasks for resumption.

operation:MODEL_ACTIVATE.description: Activates a reviewed Alpha model for this workspace's research.

operation:MODEL_DEACTIVATE.description: Removes an activated Alpha model from this workspace's catalog.

operation:MODEL_EXTENSIONS.description: Lists installed and extension Alpha models, each with its review packet.

operation:MODEL_TRAINING_INPUT_PLAN.description: Plans model inputs for a component on a research input; fitting and validation follow in the Alpha study.

operation:MODEL_TRAINING_INPUT_PREPARE.description: Prepares planned model inputs as a Task, or reuses them; no model is fit or validated.

operation:MODEL_TRAINING_INPUT_READBACK.description: Shows the model-input preparation Task, sources and support; fitting and validation are later Alpha study work.

operation:NETWORK_ACCESS.description: Shows whether this workspace may reach the network and what decided it.

operation:NETWORK_ACCESS_SET.description: Turns this workspace's network access on or off.

operation:OPERATION_LIST.description: Lists every operation with its required and allowed fields, and the request schema.

operation:PENDING_DECISIONS.description: Lists everything waiting on a person, each with the request that takes it.

operation:PLAN.description: Previews an installed strategy's book from its controls: window, reuse and work; nothing runs.

operation:PORTFOLIO_READBACK.description: Reads one exact book's saved report or latest Forward composite.

operation:PORTFOLIO_UPDATE_PLAN.description: Plans a Portfolio update that settles observed sessions for an installed package; fits nothing.

operation:PORTFOLIO_UPDATE_READBACK.description: Shows a Portfolio update Task, or a strategy's latest, with the book it published.

operation:PORTFOLIO_UPDATE_RUN.description: Runs a planned Portfolio update as a Task, or reuses the identical published one.

operation:RECOVER.description: Resumes a Task that needs recovery, or retries a blocked study whose artifact was repaired.

operation:REPORT.description: Opens a saved result's report: window, book, controls and readouts; reruns nothing.

operation:RESEARCH_HISTORY.description: Lists past studies, installed results, updates and CRO reviews, a page at a time.

operation:RESEARCH_INPUTS.description: Lists each research input and its versions, naming any that cannot be read.

operation:RESEARCH_INPUT_CONFIRM.description: Confirms a planned research input capture, which seals a new input version as a Task.

operation:RESEARCH_INPUT_PLAN.description: Plans sealing a new version of a research input from the local sources; no network.

operation:RESEARCH_INPUT_READBACK.description: Shows an input capture Task and the input version it published.

operation:RESEARCH_STRATEGY_CONTROLS.description: Shows the strategy-preparation declaration schema and the completed Alpha and Risk studies it can use.

operation:RESEARCH_STRATEGY_INSTALL.description: Installs a prepared strategy as non-default research in this workspace; the running service serves its packages at once.

operation:RESEARCH_STRATEGY_PLAN.description: Plans a strategy preparation from promoted Alpha and Risk studies; nothing runs.

operation:RESEARCH_STRATEGY_PREPARE.description: Prepares the planned strategy's Portfolio inputs from its Alpha and Risk studies, as a Task.

operation:RESEARCH_STRATEGY_READBACK.description: Shows a strategy preparation Task, what it prepared and what is still missing.

operation:RESEARCH_UPDATE_AUTOMATION_CON.description: Turns the daily research update on or off for named packages.

operation:RESEARCH_UPDATE_AUTOMATION_REA.description: Shows whether the daily research update is on, its packages and next due time.

operation:RESEARCH_UPDATE_PLAN.description: Plans a research update bringing data, scores, calibration and the book to the latest completed session, or to the close before --date, the trade date whose positions it yields.

operation:RESEARCH_UPDATE_READBACK.description: Shows a research update Task, or a strategy's latest, with the book it published.

operation:RESEARCH_UPDATE_RUN.description: Runs a planned research update as one Task, or reuses the identical completed one.

operation:RESULTS.description: Lists result metadata, for one Task when selected; opens no reports.

operation:RUN.description: Runs an installed strategy's book from its controls, or reuses an identical saved result.

operation:SESSION_USAGE_READ.description: Reads the bound conversations' numerical native telemetry from the catalog; nothing else runs, and reading off reads nothing.

operation:STATUS.description: Shows one Task's state, stages, timing and incident; may wait for it to move on.

operation:STORAGE_CAP_SET.description: Sets the workspace storage cap to auto or a positive whole byte count; preserves retained work.

operation:STORAGE_CAP_SHOW.description: Shows the operator storage cap, its automatic estimate and free disk.

operation:STORAGE_CONFIRM.description: Applies a storage clean-up plan, deleting the Panel chunks it names.

operation:STORAGE_EVIDENCE_REBUILD.description: Deprecated, removed in 0.3.0: refuses; the retrieval store keeps no evidence index.

operation:STORAGE_PIN.description: Refuses: a research input takes no pin and the retrieval store keeps no evidence index.

operation:STORAGE_PLAN.description: Plans a storage clean-up of Panel chunks and saves it for confirmation.

operation:STORAGE_READBACK.description: Shows storage use, evidence bytes and pending clean-up; inputs: `input list`.

operation:STRATEGY_ACTIVATE.description: Runs a reviewed book's installed research strategy forward: the daily update scores, calibrates and gives its next positions; a person's.

operation:STRATEGY_CALIBRATION_PLAN.description: Plans calibration of a package's Portfolio input from a published score snapshot; fits nothing.

operation:STRATEGY_CALIBRATION_READBACK.description: Shows a calibration Task, or a strategy's latest, and the Portfolio input it published.

operation:STRATEGY_CALIBRATION_RUN.description: Prepares a package's Portfolio input from a calibration plan as a Task, or reuses it.

operation:STRATEGY_DEACTIVATE.description: Stops an installed research strategy running forward; its history stays readable; a person's.

operation:STRATEGY_SCORE_PLAN.description: Plans scoring of a package's models for a formation session; nothing is scored yet.

operation:STRATEGY_SCORE_READBACK.description: Shows a scoring Task, or a strategy's latest, and the score snapshot it published.

operation:STRATEGY_SCORE_RUN.description: Runs a planned scoring as a Task, or reuses the identical published score.

operation:TASKS.description: Lists the workspace's Tasks with their states, or one agent session's, a page at a time.

operation:TASK_GUARDIAN.description: Reads every unfinished Task: liveness, stages, kept work, incidents and permitted recovery.

operation:TASK_INCIDENTS.description: Lists the supervisor's incident records, open first, with what was done about each.

operation:TASK_RECOVERY.description: Shows what stopped a Task, what stays verified and what recovery its owner permits.

operation:TASK_REMEDIATE.description: Performs one remedy the Host offers for an open incident: cancel, recover or re-plan.

operation:UPGRADE_ACKNOWLEDGE.description: Records the installed identities you saw on the upgrade overview, by their set hash.

operation:UPGRADE_OVERVIEW.description: Shows what the installed upgrade changed: saved studies, reviews and waiting Tasks.

operation:USAGE_READING.description: Shows whether the Host may receive and read native agent telemetry, and what it keeps.

operation:USAGE_READING_SET.description: Turns reading the bound agent Sessions' usage on or off for this workspace.

operation:WAKE_REGISTER.description: Asks the Host to queue one line to a Codex thread, naming the exact read, when the Task ends, needs a decision or is deferred; returns at once, the wake held in the Task's journal across turns and restarts.

operation:WORKSPACE_BACKUP.description: Backs up what the workspace cannot rebuild, outside it, keeping the newest generations.

operation:WORKSPACE_BACKUPS.description: Lists the kept backup generations and the backup root; makes none.

operation:WORKSPACE_PREPARE_CONFIRM.description: Starts a planned workspace preparation: the CLI starts one under the workspace's first-use goal, or resumes one under a person's grant.

operation:WORKSPACE_PREPARE_PLAN.description: Plans first-use workspace preparation, or recovery of a stopped one; acquires nothing.

operation:WORKSPACE_PREPARE_READBACK.description: Shows the latest preparation Task, or the one named, and the inputs it published.

operation:WORKSPACE_SHOW.description: Shows the workspace's inputs, recent studies and Tasks, data state, and next steps.

port:clock.description: Wall time and calendar-date access through the kernel clock port.

port:config.description: Configuration access through the kernel config port.

ConfigPort: get(self, name: str, default: str | None=None) -> str | None

port:door.description: Operation admission and dispatch boundary through the kernel door port.

DoorPort: dispatch(self, operation: str, call: CallT) -> AnswerT

port:egress.description: Outbound access boundary through the kernel egress port.

EgressPort: stream(self, url: str, *, headers: Mapping[str, str] | None=None) -> AbstractContextManager[HttpResponse]

port:execution.description: Task execution, scheduling and cancellation through the kernel execution port.

ExecutionPort: submit(self, action: Callable[[], T], *, lane: ExecutionLane='background') -> Future[T]
running(self, execution_id: UUID, timeout: float | None, heartbeat: ExecutionHeartbeat) -> AbstractContextManager[None]
register_pool(self, pool: T, *, name: str) -> T

port:identity.description: Canonical identity and digest operations through the kernel identity port.

port:kernel_resources.description: Resource budgets and leases through the kernel resources port.

ResourcesPort: grant(self, holder: str | UUID, request: ResourceAmounts) -> ResourceLease

port:layout.description: Data-root and workspace path layout through the kernel layout port.

port:ledger.description: Ordered durable event records through the kernel ledger port.

port:lifecycle.description: Host lifetime and supervision through the kernel lifecycle port.

port:locks.description: Lock and lease primitives through the kernel locks port.

port:storage.description: Persistent storage sessions and objects through the kernel storage port.

Driver: connect(self, target: str, *, read_only: bool, config: Mapping[str, object]) -> Any

callables.connect: (target: 'str', *, read_only: 'bool' = False, config: 'Mapping[str, object] | None' = None) -> 'Any'
callables.schema: (root: 'str', table: 'str | tuple[str, str]', revision: 'int', read: 'Callable[[], T]', *, installed_revision: 'Callable[[], int] | None' = None, recheck: 'Callable[[T], T] | None' = None) -> 'T'

port:telemetry.description: Instrumentation and exporter boundary through the kernel telemetry port.

port:types.description: Clock-independent value and type contracts through the kernel types port.
